focuses.desc:
China has surrendered. The coast and Nanjing are Japan's; the interior has been handed to Wang Jingwei's Reorganized National Government, seated at Wuhan, an Imperial Associate of Japan. Its slogan is Peace, Anti-Communism, National Reconstruction. Its purpose, as Tokyo sees it, is rice, iron, tungsten and labour.

HOW RNG GETS THIS TREE (built): Japan's dictated peace in China (tools/gen_jap_china_peace.py) creates RNG. A player who was playing Nationalist China becomes RNG.

THE LEASH (always): RNG can never leave Japan. Its autonomy can never rise above Imperial Associate - every focus that sounds like independence only changes how it serves. If Japan collapses, RNG falls with it (to design later).

LENGTH: about 8 years per playthrough, ending around 1950-52.

THE HOLLOW ECONOMY (to build - the heart of this tree). Unlike other trees, this one is meant to RUIN RNG's own economy. The government's only goal is value for Tokyo; it works at first, then it fails.
- ECONOMIC DECAY, 0-100, on RNG. Starts at 0. Almost every Extraction and Serving Tokyo focus adds Decay (the number is in each focus). From Total Mobilisation of Resources it also rises by 0.5 every month, for good. Every factory the rebels blow up adds 3, every wrecked mine 2. Only Japan's decisions can lower it, and only for a while.
- The spirit The Hollow Economy follows Decay:
    0-24   Tokyo's Workshop (the boom): +10% factory output, +5% construction speed.
    25-49  Running on Credit: -10% construction speed, -15% repair speed, +5% consumer goods.
    50-74  Stripped Bare: -10% factory output, -30% construction speed, -40% repair speed, +10% consumer goods, -10% max factory efficiency.
    75-99  A Hollow Shell: -20% factory output, -50% construction speed, -65% repair speed, +15% consumer goods, -20% max factory efficiency, -10% stability.
    100    On the Brink: -30% factory output, -70% construction speed, -85% repair speed, +20% consumer goods, -30% max factory efficiency, -15% stability.
  By the end of the tree, every factory the rebels destroy is felt: almost nothing gets repaired or rebuilt.
- JAPAN'S SIDE (to build): the spirit The China Dividend on Japan follows RNG's Decay. While Decay is low, Japan gains (+2 civilian factories, +5% factory output from Chinese resources). At 50+ the gains shrink to nothing. At 75+ it becomes The China Burden: -5% factory output, +5% consumer goods - the colony that was meant to feed Japan now has to be fed. (Later, the same burden can grow from Japan's other exploited subjects.)
- JAPAN PROPS UP WUHAN (decisions, Japan only):
    Emergency Rice Shipments: Japan -2 civilian factories for 90 days (consumer goods); RNG Decay -5, +5% stability for 90 days.
    Send Japanese Engineers: Japan -1000 manpower, -50 political power; RNG +50% repair speed for 90 days.
    Bail Out the Central Reserve Bank: Japan -100 political power; Decay stops rising for 180 days.
    Tighten the Quotas: the reverse - Japan +2 civilian factories for 180 days, RNG Decay +8, every resistance +3.
  None of these can bring Decay down for good. The diversion is the point: Japan pays more and more to keep its colony alive.
- THE END: the tree's last focus, The Collapse Begins (not before 1950), starts the crash. The real crisis comes in a later addition; this tree is the build-up.

THE THREE RESISTANCES (to build - like Tito's Partisans in Croatia, three times over). Each has its own Strength, 0-100, on RNG, and NEVER falls below 10: the regime can contain them, never destroy them.

1. THE COMMUNIST GUERRILLAS (New Fourth Army and Eighth Route Army remnants). Start 25. Hideouts: Anhui, Huangshan, Shanxi, Henan. Funded by PRC decisions once the PRC post-war tree exists (not built now).
2. THE LOYALIST ARMY (KMT guerrillas, the Loyal and Patriotic Army). Start 20. Hideouts: Sichuan, Chengdu, Guizhou, Hunan. Funded by the Northwestern Army - the rump Nationalist government that still holds the northwest (ASSUMED: CHI after the peace).
3. THE CHINESE LIBERATION LEAGUE (no party, every class - students, workers, bandits, deserters). Start 15. Hideouts: Yunnan, Liangshan, Hubei, Xian. BOTH the PRC and the Northwestern Army can fund it.

GROWTH: every month each grows by 1 (+1 while RNG is at war). Exploitation feeds them: every extraction focus adds a permanent grievance to the group it angers most (+0.25 a month each), every atrocity adds a grievance to ALL THREE. Foreign funding adds more.

OPERATIONS - INDUSTRIAL SABOTAGE AND FREEING PEOPLE. Each needs a minimum strength and spends some:
  Cut the railway          needs 10, costs 3:  infrastructure damaged in a state, -5% factory output for 30 days.
  Free a labour column     needs 20, costs 4:  RNG loses 3000 manpower and one month of the Labour Quotas output; the group +2 (the freed men join).
  Wreck a mine             needs 30, costs 6:  a mine state loses resources for 60 days (Daye iron, Jiangxi tungsten, Gejiu tin first). JAPAN loses the same imports.
  Strike in the factories  needs 40, costs 8:  a factory state: -10% output for 60 days, -2% stability.
  Blow up a factory        needs 50, costs 10: a civilian or military factory destroyed.
  Break open a labour camp needs 60, costs 12: -10000 manpower, -3% stability, the group +5, the Labour Quotas spirit falls a tier for 90 days.
  Liberated district       needs 75, costs 20: a hideout state passes to that resistance as a rebel country at war with RNG.
  Strike at a Japanese convoy needs 85, costs 15: Japan loses equipment and convoys; Japan's patience with RNG falls.
Each group has a favourite: Communists - free people and liberated districts; Loyalists - mines, factories and assassination of collaborators; Liberation League - strikes and camp breakouts. They plan like Tito: pick a reachable target, save for it, settle lower if held down.

RNG FIGHTS BACK (decisions): Locate the hideouts (one per group); Sweep a hideout state (political power, rifles, manpower; on the hideout -12 strength and 60 days to ground, otherwise -2 or a cell found); Reprisals (-5 now, +0.25 a month for good - the Croatian rule: terror always costs).

JAPAN SUPPORTS RNG (decisions, to build, Japan only, while RNG is its subject):
  Send Arms to Wuhan - 3000 rifles to RNG.
  Kempeitai Detachment - RNG knows where every hideout is for 60 days.
  Punitive Expedition against one group - Japanese manpower and command power: that group -10.
  Yokohama Specie Bank Loan - RNG +100 political power, Japan pays civilian factories for 90 days.
  Garrison Reinforcement - a Japanese garrison division in a threatened state; Railway sabotage there fails.
  Tighten the Quotas - more resources and labour for Japan, every group +3. (The exploitation tree in reverse.)

FUNDING THE RESISTANCE (decisions, to build):
  Northwestern Army: Fund the Loyalists, Fund the Liberation League, Smuggle Officers Through the Lines.
  PRC: Fund the Communists, Fund the Liberation League (wait for the PRC post-war tree).
  Funding costs political power and equipment, raises that group's monthly growth for 180 days, and Japan gets an opinion malus with the funder.
